notes: SmallHD "Focus Pro" is a distinct SKU (MON-FOCUS-PRO) from the older "FOCUS 5\" Base HDMI/SDI" line — this device is SDI-only, purpose-built for RED KOMODO cameras (5-pin control port drives KOMODO menu/control). No HDMI input exists on this model. Manufacturer page (smallhd.com/products/focus-pro) confirms display specs, SDI input, headphone jack, 2-pin power input, and 5-pin USB control port; B&H product listing (https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1578339-REG/smallhd_mon_focus_pro_focus_pro_monitor.html) corroborates and adds the 3G/HD/SD-SDI grade detail and confirms the power connector is a 2-pin LEMO type and that the unit is Sony L-series battery powered. Desktop/camera-top accessory monitor — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Weight 9.6 oz, 5\" 1280x720 LCD, 800 cd/m², milled aluminum chassis, PageOS software (waveform/vectorscope/histogram/3D LUT/focus assist).

ports.name: Camera Control
ports.note: Proprietary 5-pin locking USB-style connector used for RED KOMODO camera control, not a standard data/host USB port; no bandwidth grade applicable

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: Actual connector is a locking 2-pin LEMO-style power connector (7-16.8V), not a literal barrel jack — closest taxonomy match. Unit also mounts a Sony L-series battery plate as an alternate/primary power source (not a fixed port).
